authority: Root read-only review; lab_ci_audit explicitly cleared exclusive write of this one new review file.
scope: Only readiness/error retry/deadline/load identity/unchanged HTML and shared transport. No browser, game, helper replay or test execution by this reviewer.

findings.detail: Only a tagged protocol error from Runtime.evaluate, numeric code -32000, and exact message Inspected target navigated or closed is tolerated. Unmatched protocol errors, ordinary Error objects, JS runtime exceptions and deadlines propagate.

The catch that may continue applies only to !!window.prismQa&&prismQa.initialized(). prismQa.ready() executes at most once per existing phase and its failure throws outside that retry catch. No input, purchase, Page.reload or Page.navigate operation is retried.

One started+10000 deadline is shared by every probe and the single ready action. Each evaluate is raced against only the remaining budget; pauses are capped to the remainder. Timers are cleared in finally.

All three Page.reload calls retain prior window.prismQa=null invalidation. The raw legacy bootstrap, removal of its next-document script, seed/slot identity, one-time refund assertions, backup roundtrip, and paid cold-load assertions are unchanged. Five labels only identify the already-existing initial/intro/three-reload phases.

The generated driver prefix containing source/prelude/bridge/HTML construction and server is byte-identical before and after. The shared Prism driver remains hash 8009b22e; readiness edits are Tree wrapper transformations only.

nonBlockingLimit.description: The 10-second bound covers readiness, not the unchanged failure screenshot/diagnostics/teardown. A timed-out CDP request is not cancelled at protocol level; its eventual settlement has no retry or continuation path that can replay ready/input actions. The outer run remains failed and closes the browser.
nonBlockingLimit.action: No code change required for the requested scope.

remaining: Actual Chromium CI must establish readiness and all original game/UI assertions on the frozen candidate. This static review is not browser acceptance.
